profiling.nsight_compute: Driver profiling resource unavailable; no hardware counter claims.

protocol.precision: unchanged BF16; fixed inputs; candidate==control bitwise

shape_regression_grid.scope: B1/B2, sequence lengths 128 through 16384; three rotated rounds. Native SDPA still wins several power-of-two cases.

datasets.scope: Actual captured BF16 text inference inputs; forward only, projection strides and offsets retained. Each comparison uses one GPU; schema and final backbone now share the model-investigation H100.

protocol.timing: Median CUDA-event milliseconds per attention call, including schema merge; compilation excluded.

datasets.scope: Actual BF16 Clef 27B backbone captures, causal D256 GQA24/4. Projection strides and offsets retained. All backends share the same device and native ABI; the prior CuTe control swaps the pre-Hopper device kernels.

protocol.timing: Median CUDA-event milliseconds per attention call; compilation excluded.

clef_flash_model_validation.scope: BF16 text inference, synthetic four-choice records; no vision measurements or precision changes.

native_build.cache_key: C++ source content; separate native build per revision, independent of source mtimes.

full_gpu_suite.source_phase: full_gpu_suite; before native loader cache fix and final replay additions

post_cache_fix.scope: Four schema GPU tests, including dynamic compiled query boundaries; three benchmark CPU tests and preserved-mtime build regression.

integrated_replay_verification.scope: Final public-API replay validation on the model-investigation GPU, separately from seven-round schema and five-round backbone qualification tables.
integrated_replay_verification.interpretation: Head gains reproduce. Two-round long-backbone samples are variable and do not establish an SDPA win.

whole_model.units: milliseconds per encoded batch through device logits
whole_model.interpretation: Timing distributions overlap; no reliable end-to-end SDPA win or large improvement over previous CuTe is established. Both CuTe versions retain native model-gate failures; those failures are not waived.

setup_errors.initial_reason: The GPU image lacked Git and the source-only runtime bundle omitted required test support files.

final_hopper_gpu_tests.scope: 21 serial128 output/gradient/statistics configurations, strict FP64 output and all-gradient checks over six signed/zero/tiny scales, changed Q/K/V graph inputs, and infinity/NaN propagation.

integrated_replay.scope: All 65261568 values in actual backbone captures; schema path unchanged and its earlier four replay records retained separately.

expanded_fp64_stress.scope: One BF16 dK element at B1/GQA24:4/Sq257/Sk129/D256/scale-0.125 exceeds the unchanged .02abs/.02rel bound in both the new kernel and serial64/serial128 controls. Exact tensors and comparisons retained.

tie_diagnostic.scope: FP64 reference for six explicit schema SDPA calls, rounded to BF16 at attention outputs; backbone, head projections/MLPs and native MHA fastpath unchanged. This is not a full FP64 model or task accuracy evaluation.

whole_model.scope: Encoded batch through BF16 device logits; native MHA fastpaths and linear attention retained. Synthetic unlabeled records.
whole_model.timing_gate: Unchanged .02abs/.02rel and zero decision flips versus prior CuTe.
whole_model.timing_exclusion_reason: Both records fail the unchanged model logit gate; the long record changes one decision relative to prior CuTe. No whole-model speedup is claimed.

profiling.interpretation: Dynamic warp instruction totals and sampled stalls are not percentages of elapsed time. Extra producer warps parked at the final barrier inflate active-warp counters; these do not establish productive occupancy. Default SDPA is verified as cuDNN on both actual captures.

exponent_fold_exhaustive.scope: Compare two RN multiplies followed by ex2.approx.ftz against the folded default-scale expression for every finite FP32 bit pattern with its sign bit set: negative zero, all negative subnormals and all finite negative values.

design_changes: N128 key tiles with independent single-stage K/V producers and two M64 consumer warpgroups.
All four warps contribute to each ordered softmax phase token; the single-arrival prototype was rejected after sanitizer deadlock.
Runtime-uniform sign/default-scale branches outside the tile loop, delayed denominator reduction and exact default-scale exponent folding.
Head-major grid with longest causal query tiles first.

small_shape_alternative.scope: S128/256/512, existing serial M64/N128, 8 balanced rounds, 32 calls/graph, 500ms windows, 5s preheat and full FP64/changed-input guards.
small_shape_alternative.reason: Slower than the safe specialized kernel at all three lengths. Native cuDNN remains faster there.
small_shape_alternative.native_dispatch: Same cuDNN64x128x256 knob7 kernel family; underfilled grids24/48/96 blocks.

fp64_attention_model_reference.scope: All explicit SDPA calls use FP64 QK/softmax/PV and BF16 outputs; native MHA fastpaths and linear attention retained; unmodified BF16 weights. No labeled task-accuracy claim.

broader_shape_grid.scope: BF16 causal GQA24/4 D256, scale0.0625, BSHD-strided V. Eight B1 square lengths128 through16384 and two rectangular B1/B2 shapes. Default SDPA beats CuTe on lengths128/256/512. Forced FlashAttention rejects rectangular causal shapes.
